ownScientificSourceReason: The actual HE39 LK bullet explicitly differentiates SN1 at tertiary and SN2 at primary carbon and asks inductive/steric effects. The whole target interpreting kinetics/solvent/substrate is scientifically connected: rate-limiting ionisation versus concerted bimolecular attack motivates different concentration dependence; carbocation stabilisation, steric approach and solvation influence competition. It must not become a universal primary/tertiary or solvent rule independent of nucleophile/leaving group/conditions. Kinetic orders and solvent choices are explanatory transfer dimensions, not literally enumerated separate source bullets. The retained broad c2d3 cluster and its donor/acceptor, equation and halide-test children do not by their three actual descriptions separately certify all the LK mechanism differentiation. No historical exact edge is promoted into new whole-source approval.
scopeAndOperatorLimits: Keep the LK-specific primary/tertiary contrast and inductive/steric mechanisms explicitly assessable in a later operative witness; retain equations, donor/acceptor and chloride/bromide detection duties. No finite new P cases or laboratory execution are present in this source-role input.

wholeCurrentTarget.description: Die lernende Person kann die Reaktivität von Carbonsäurechloriden, Carbonsäureanhydriden und Carbonsäureestern bei vergleichbaren nucleophilen Acylsubstitutionen ordnen und die Unterschiede anhand von Carbonylgruppe und Abgangsgruppe begründen.
wholeCurrentTarget.descriptionEn: The learner can rank the reactivity of carboxylic acid chlorides, carboxylic acid anhydrides, and carboxylic esters in comparable nucleophilic acyl substitutions and justify the differences using the carbonyl group and leaving group.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Carbonsäure-Derivate vergleichen
resourceLinks.altText: Comicartige Strukturübersicht eines vergleichbaren nucleophilen Acylsubstitutionsfalls: Carbonsäurechlorid, Carbonsäureanhydrid und Carbonsäureester werden anhand ihrer Carbonyl- und Abgangsgruppen verglichen. Die schematische Rangfolge betrifft diese vergleichbaren Fälle, keine beliebigen Chloride oder universelle Geschwindigkeit unter unterschiedlichen Bedingungen.

ownScientificSourceReason: Actual RP40 raster separates left Fundamentum, right LK Additum and a full-width optional deepening block. Acid amides, anhydrides and chlorides are in that optional block; the source does not literally require this three-analyte ranking as compulsory LK content. Comparing acid chloride/anhydride/ester for comparable nucleophilic acyl substitution is sound when comparable acyl group/nucleophile/solvent/temperature are held: leaving-group stability/basicity and carbonyl donation/electrophilicity explain relative tendency. It is not a ranking for arbitrary chlorides or all conditions. The actual original optional clause also includes amides and pharmaceutical/polymer links; this target cannot stand for all those items. All15 original mapped partners and their25 current whole partner/descendant bodies are preserved; their historical mapped verdict is not reapproved.
scopeAndOperatorLimits: Preserve original amide and every partner/operator. New role is an explicitly authored comparative transfer, not literal HE compulsory content or RP LK Additum. RP extraction sourceRef S21/passage.page21 and courseLevelLK remain historical metadata requiring honest actual40/optional scope in any operative successor.

wholeCurrentTarget.description: Die lernende Person kann die intramolekulare Esterbildung aus vorgegebenen Hydroxycarbonsäuren anhand von Strukturformeln erklären und Bildungstendenz sowie relative Stabilität der entstehenden Lactone unter angegebenen Bedingungen anhand von Ringstruktur und Vergleichsdaten begründen.
wholeCurrentTarget.descriptionEn: The learner can explain intramolecular ester formation from specified hydroxycarboxylic acids using structural formulas and justify the formation tendency and relative stability of the resulting lactones under stated conditions using ring structure and comparative data.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Ringbildung und Lactone
resourceLinks.description: Visualisierung zum Lernziel: Ringbildung und Lactone.
resourceLinks.altText: Comicartige intramolekulare Esterbildung einer geeigneten Hydroxycarbonsäure zu einem fünfgliedrigen Lacton mit Wasser als Kondensationsprodukt. Der Ring enthält Ester-Sauerstoff und Carbonylkohlenstoff. Das Beispiel zeigt keine allgemeine Stabilitätsregel für sämtliche Fünf- oder Sechsringe.

ownScientificSourceReason: Actual HE39 Q1.3 requires the ester class, nomenclature, structure representations, condensation and mechanism; it does not literally mention lactones or a universal ring-stability law. Using specified hydroxycarboxylic-acid structures for intramolecular ester formation is a genuine chemical transfer: hydroxyl oxygen joins the carboxyl carbon, the ring includes ester oxygen and carbonyl carbon, and water is the condensation product in the model. Ring strain/conformation and reaction conditions/equilibrium affect relative formation/stability; supplied comparison data are needed, so the actual conditional goal avoids a blanket five/six-ring rule. Ester naming, observations/properties/applications and actual mechanistic partner98ae remain distinct duties.
scopeAndOperatorLimits: Keep whole70b and98ae partners, original2partial edges and nomenclature/structural-mechanism gaps. This single conditional LK transfer does not silently replace the whole GK/LK ester class source group or approve every listed jurisdiction.

wholeCurrentTarget.title: Redoxbasierte Konservierung
wholeCurrentTarget.description: Die lernende Person kann redoxaktive Konservierungsstrategien am Beispiel von Ascorbinsäure anhand bereitgestellter Reaktions- und Vergleichsdaten bewerten und dabei antioxidative Wirkung von antimikrobieller Konservierung unterscheiden.
wholeCurrentTarget.descriptionEn: The learner can evaluate redox-active preservation strategies using ascorbic acid as an example and supplied reaction and comparison data, and distinguish antioxidant action from antimicrobial preservation.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Redoxbasierte Konservierung
resourceLinks.altText: Freundliches Redoxmodell: Ascorbinsäure gibt Elektronen an ein Oxidationsmittel ab und wird oxidiert; das Oxidationsmittel wird reduziert. Getrennte Mikroorganismen und die Beschriftung antioxidativ≠antimikrobiell zeigen die Grenze der Konservierungsaussage. Die Figuren sind keine Molekülstrukturformeln oder eigenen Messergebnisse.

ownScientificSourceReason: Actual HE40 Q1.5 basic-level clause is qualitative detection of ascorbic acid as antioxidant. The target instead evaluates supplied redox/comparison data and explicitly distinguishes antioxidant effect from antimicrobial preservation. Ascorbic acid may donate reducing equivalents and be oxidised while an oxidant is reduced; delay of oxidation alone does not establish inhibition of microbial growth, storage safety or product permission. Whole db666 partner still requires carrying out the qualitative reagent test and explaining its observed reduction. Provided data in this extra LK evaluation do not waive that actual conduct duty.
scopeAndOperatorLimits: Q1.5 is outside the compulsory Q1 fields1–3 stated on actual HE38; apply the selected-theme context and its basic/LK internal levels faithfully. No universal LK duty, actual experiment, therapeutic efficacy or food-safety approval follows from this candidate.
